ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create a page anchor, such as resources-videos. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

Eyebrow.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the section heading.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the video list.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Short introduction shown above the videos. Formatted text and links are allowed.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Watch brief explainers, product conversations, and field notes from the team.

Videos.helper: Add each video resource here. Categories and tags are simple text fields so this template can remain independent.

Title.helper: Required. Public title for this video.

Description.helper: Optional. Short description shown below the video.
Description.placeholder: A draft overview of how teams can evaluate and operationalize technical decisions.

YouTubeUrl.helper: Optional. Paste a YouTube watch, youtu.be, shorts, or embed web addresses. The public embed uses youtube-nocookie.com when the video ID can be parsed.

ThumbnailImage.helper:
Optional fallback image shown when no usable YouTube web addresses is configured. Recommended minimum: 1280 x 720 px.

Default Thumbnail: To use the default YouTube thumbnail, grab it from this third-party site using the YouTube web addresses.

ThumbnailAlt.helper: Describe the thumbnail for assistive technology. Leave empty only if the image is decorative.

Category.helper: Optional. Simple label shown above the title and used for grouping when multiple categories exist.

Tags.helper: Optional. Comma-separated tags shown as small badges.

CtaText.helper: Optional. Link text shown below the description. If empty, the YouTube web addresses is used as a source link only when a fallback card renders.

CtaUrl.helper: Optional. Link web addresses for the button. If empty, the YouTube web addresses is used when button text is present.

CtaTarget.helper: Open the button in the same tab or a new tab. New tabs automatically receive noopener and noreferrer.
